title: Machine Learning Engineer
text:
We are hiring a senior Machine Learning Engineer to work on systems that are already in production and already load-bearing. You will own services end to end: design, ship, operate, and answer the pager for them.

You will be expected to reason carefully about data leakage — leakage, validation, ml.

You will be expected to reason carefully about statistical inference — statistics, inference, significance.

You will be expected to reason carefully about feature engineering — feature, machine learning, model.

You will be expected to reason carefully about model evaluation — evaluation, metric, model.

You will be expected to reason carefully about data quality — data quality, validation, pipeline.

You will be expected to reason carefully about experiment design — experiment, a/b test, ml.

You will be expected to reason carefully about causal reasoning — causal, confounding, observational.

You will be expected to reason carefully about pipeline orchestration — pipeline, airflow, etl.

We care much more about how you think through an unfamiliar problem than about which frameworks appear on your CV. Expect the interview to be technical and specific.
